primaryTextRead.text: Over the camels was Obil the Ishmaelite. Over the donkeys was Jehdeiah the Meronothite. Over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagrite.

wikipediaRead.title: List of minor Hebrew Bible figures, L–Z — Obil
wikipediaRead.locator: L–Z人物一覧836行はオビルをイスマエル人のラクダ管理者とし、1CH27:30を直接引用する。
